posts.text: Quite surprised to find that natural gas consumption has actually increased compared to last year, and even imports have increased. One would have thought, with prices more than doubling in the last 12 months, there would have been a drop in demand for natural gas, but it seems like this trend is more secular than one had imagined. The Economic Times Natural gas imports rise despite price surge India's natural gas imports are increasing despite higher prices this fiscal year.
